reviewItem.question: Does "Compose any resource: Crossplane v2 isn't opinionated about using composition together with managed resources" mean a change to protocol-behavior:crossplane|name=compose-any-resource (behavior-changed)?

proposed.statement: Crossplane v2 compositions can compose any resource (MRs, Deployments, third-party CRs), but Crossplane must be granted access to compose non-Crossplane resources.
